articles.headline: Newcastle owners not considering full sale, only minority deals - reports
articles.description: Newcastle's Saudi owners are not treating the possibility of selling a minority stake in the club as the first step towards a full sale, the Press Association understands.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Newcastle eye Inter's Pio Esposito
articles.description: Both Arsenal and Newcastle United are looking to improve their attack by signing Inter's Pio Esposito. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.headline: Guimarães: Newcastle fans that booed me 'can't delete my history with the club'
articles.description: Bruno Guimarães has told the Newcastle fans who booed his return to St James Park that they "cannot delete the history I have with the club."

articles.headline: David Raya to be assessed after leaving Arsenal's draw at Newcastle with injury
articles.description: David Raya was forced off with an injury during Arsenal's 2-2 draw at Newcastle United on Saturday.

articles.headline: Does Newcastle draw raise first doubts over Arsenal's title defence?
articles.description: James Olley discusses whether Arsenal's draw with Newcastle is an early warning sign in their title defence.

articles.headline: Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal: Noni Madueke rescues point for Gunners against spirited hosts - as it happened
articles.description: Arsenal missed the chance to go eight points clear at the top of the table as they were held by a spirited Newcastle.

articles.headline: Noni Madueke rescues a point for Arsenal against Newcastle in thrilling 2-2 draw
articles.description: Noni Madueke snatched a 2-2 draw for Arsenal after Newcastle produced a stunning second-half turnaround to claim a deserved point against the Premier League leaders.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Newcastle draw Arsenal, Leeds upset Chelsea
articles.description: Club soccer returned across Europe this weekend following the final international break of 2026. Check out all the highlights from Saturday's action.

articles.headline: Predicting how all 20 Premier League teams will finish the season
articles.description: After 10 games, we have enough data to predict every Premier League team's final spot in the standings for the 2026-27 season.

articles.headline: England squad: Dan Burn called up to replace injured Marc Guéhi
articles.description: Dan Burn has been called up by England to replace Marc Guéhi, who has withdrawn with an injury.

articles.headline: Late Rodrigo Muniz strike sees pressure on Matthias Jaissle and Newcastle grow
articles.description: Jacob Murphy's wonderful late strike was not enough to earn Newcastle victory at Craven Cottage, with Rodrigo Muniz levelling minutes later to earn Fulham a deserved 1-1 draw.

articles.headline: Anthony Gordon left Premier League for Barcelona to get 'respect' -- he's got it now
articles.description: Anthony Gordon's move to Barcelona was a surprise to some, but he's become an instant fan favorite at Camp Nou as well as a key player for England.

articles.headline: Newcastle's Amar Dedic prompts police action after bow and arrow sighting
articles.description: Police were dispatched after a Premier League footballer was spotted carrying a bow and arrows on a country track, it has been reported.

articles.headline: Barry leads Everton to second win over Newcastle in four days
articles.description: Thierno Barry's second-half strike helped Everton return to winning ways in the Premier League with a 1-0 victory over Newcastle at St James' Park.

articles.headline: Jack Grealish misses Everton-Newcastle due to 'breach of club discipline'
articles.description: Jack Grealish was made unavailable for Everton's Carabao Cup round of 16 match against Newcastle on Thursday due to what the club called a "breach of club discipline."

articles.headline: Michael Owen: I didn't get enough credit for winning Ballon d'Or
articles.description: Michael Owen has said that he doesn't believe he got the sort of credit that "others would" for winning the Ballon d'Or when he triumphed in 2001.

articles.headline: David Moyes: Everton in the Carabao Cup quarterfinals 'sounds good'
articles.description: David Moyes has said that talking about Everton in the quarterfinals of the Carabao Cup "sounds good" after his side comfortably beat Newcastle United on Thursday.

articles.headline: Everton 3-1 Newcastle: Hosts cruise into Carabao Cup quarterfinal - as it happened
articles.description: Everton set up a quarterfinal visit to Fleetwood Town with a comfortable 3-1 victory over Newcastle.

articles.headline: Everton beat Newcastle to set up Carabao quarters match with Fleetwood
articles.description: Everton set up a Carabao Cup quarterfinal against League Two Fleetwood as they eased to a 3-1 win over Newcastle United on Thursday.

articles.headline: Carabao Cup quarterfinal draw: Liverpool to face Bournemouth
articles.description: Liverpool will host fellow Premier League side Bournemouth in the Carabao Cup quarterfinals after making it past Chelsea in a penalty shootout on Wednesday.
